title: 如何将 cpu_user_seconds 转换为 cpu 使用百分比？
answer: rate先将累计用户CPU秒转换为每秒CPU秒；单核口径为100*sum by(instance)(rate(cpu_user_seconds{job="app"}[2m]))，允许超过100%。分配CPU口径再除以同instance且大于0的核数。2m是求率窗口，不能再除以120秒。先rate再sum可识别各进程计数器重置。缺失/非正核数不产生分配口径，不伪造0。
body:
## 环境与材料
真实Prometheus 3.5.0 promtool；cpu_user_seconds在本题明确定义为每进程累计用户CPU秒。opsforge_allocated_cpu_cores是题设辅助配额核数，不假定真实exporter存在该指标。

## 操作任务
交付两条记录规则：process:user_cpu_one_core_percent, process:user_cpu_allocation_percent。第一条统计job=app、按instance聚合的单核用户CPU百分比，允许多个进程合计超过100%；第二条除以同主机有效核数。核数缺失或非正不输出分配口径。覆盖计数器重置和其他job隔离，禁止rate后再次除以时间窗。

## 产物
rules.json，组名node-semantics、interval=1m；记录名和顺序保持不变。

## 验收方法
真实promtool规则解析与多组原生PromQL求值，绝对误差1e-9；参考、未完成、错误、提前退出及合法替代。未声明实际主机CPU压力或采集器原生命名保证。
review_note: 作者候选，待独审及会话10登记；纠正原答案重复除以时间窗口的量纲错误。

exercise.environment: UID1000, pinned native Prometheus 3.5.0 promtool, controlled counter samples
exercise.verification: native promtool check/test rules; dimensional correctness, aggregation, counter reset, allocation and scope

test_files.checks/check.py:
import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile,os
PROM='/tmp/opsforge-prometheus-3.5.0/prometheus-3.5.0.linux-amd64/promtool'
assert os.getuid()==1000
assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(PROM).read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='e59210d5474e2c811a4460fb1593d708b94d58107ae62e9d44e88029bb7e5805'
def unique(pairs):
 out={}
 for k,v in pairs:
  assert k not in out,'duplicate JSON key'
  out[k]=v
 return out
rules=json.loads(pathlib.Path('rules.json').read_text(),object_pairs_hook=unique)
assert set(rules)=={'groups'} and len(rules['groups'])==1
assert rules['groups'][0]['name']=='node-semantics' and rules['groups'][0]['interval']=='1m'
assert [r.get('record')for r in rules['groups'][0]['rules']]==['process:user_cpu_one_core_percent', 'process:user_cpu_allocation_percent']
for r in rules['groups'][0]['rules']:assert set(r)=={'record','expr'} and isinstance(r['expr'],str)

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-session01-promrules-')as td:
 root=pathlib.Path(td);(root/'rules.json').write_text(json.dumps(rules));(root/'tests.json').write_text(json.dumps({'rule_files':['rules.json'],'evaluation_interval':'1m','tests':[{'interval': '1m', 'input_series': [{'series': 'cpu_user_seconds{instance="n1",job="app",process="p0"}', 'values': '0 30 60'}, {'series': 'opsforge_allocated_cpu_cores{instance="n1"}', 'values': '4 4 4'}, {'series': 'cpu_user_seconds{instance="n1",job="other"}', 'values': '0 600 1200'}], 'promql_expr_test': [{'expr': 'abs(process:user_cpu_one_core_percent - 50) < bool 1e-9', 'eval_time': '2m', 'exp_samples': [{'labels': '{instance="n1"}', 'value': 1}]}, {'expr': 'abs(process:user_cpu_allocation_percent - 12.5) < bool 1e-9', 'eval_time': '2m', 'exp_samples': [{'labels': '{instance="n1"}', 'value': 1}]}]}, {'interval': '1m', 'input_series': [{'series': 'cpu_user_seconds{instance="n1",job="app",process="p0"}', 'values': '0 60 120'}, {'series': 'cpu_user_seconds{instance="n1",job="app",process="p1"}', 'values': '0 60 120'}, {'series': 'opsforge_allocated_cpu_cores{instance="n1"}', 'values': '4 4 4'}, {'series': 'cpu_user_seconds{instance="n1",job="other"}', 'values': '0 600 1200'}], 'promql_expr_test': [{'expr': 'abs(process:user_cpu_one_core_percent - 200) < bool 1e-9', 'eval_time': '2m', 'exp_samples': [{'labels': '{instance="n1"}', 'value': 1}]}, {'expr': 'abs(process:user_cpu_allocation_percent - 50.0) < bool 1e-9', 'eval_time': '2m', 'exp_samples': [{'labels': '{instance="n1"}', 'value': 1}]}]}, {'interval': '1m', 'input_series': [{'series': 'cpu_user_seconds{instance="n2",job="app",process="p0"}', 'values': '0 120 30'}, {'series': 'opsforge_allocated_cpu_cores{instance="n2"}', 'values': '2 2 2'}, {'series': 'cpu_user_seconds{instance="n2",job="other"}', 'values': '0 600 1200'}], 'promql_expr_test': [{'expr': 'abs(process:user_cpu_one_core_percent - 50) < bool 1e-9', 'eval_time': '2m', 'exp_samples': [{'labels': '{instance="n2"}', 'value': 1}]}, {'expr': 'abs(process:user_cpu_allocation_percent - 25.0) < bool 1e-9', 'eval_time': '2m', 'exp_samples': [{'labels': '{instance="n2"}', 'value': 1}]}]}, {'interval': '1m', 'input_series': [{'series': 'cpu_user_seconds{instance="n2",job="app",process="p0"}', 'values': '0 0 0'}, {'series': 'opsforge_allocated_cpu_cores{instance="n2"}', 'values': '1 1 1'}, {'series': 'cpu_user_seconds{instance="n2",job="other"}', 'values': '0 600 1200'}], 'promql_expr_test': [{'expr': 'abs(process:user_cpu_one_core_percent - 0) < bool 1e-9', 'eval_time': '2m', 'exp_samples': [{'labels': '{instance="n2"}', 'value': 1}]}, {'expr': 'abs(process:user_cpu_allocation_percent - 0.0) < bool 1e-9', 'eval_time': '2m', 'exp_samples': [{'labels': '{instance="n2"}', 'value': 1}]}]}, {'interval': '1m', 'input_series': [{'series': 'cpu_user_seconds{instance="n3",job="app",process="p0"}', 'values': '0 30 60'}, {'series': 'opsforge_allocated_cpu_cores{instance="n3"}', 'values': '0 0 0'}, {'series': 'cpu_user_seconds{instance="n3",job="other"}', 'values': '0 600 1200'}], 'promql_expr_test': [{'expr': 'abs(process:user_cpu_one_core_percent - 50) < bool 1e-9', 'eval_time': '2m', 'exp_samples': [{'labels': '{instance="n3"}', 'value': 1}]}, {'expr': 'process:user_cpu_allocation_percent', 'eval_time': '2m', 'exp_samples': []}]}]}))
 p=subprocess.run([PROM,'check','rules',str(root/'rules.json')],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
 print('NATIVE_RULE_CHECK:'+json.dumps({'argv':p.args,'exit_code':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr}),flush=True);assert p.returncode==0,'native rule syntax rejected'
 p=subprocess.run([PROM,'test','rules',str(root/'tests.json')],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
 print('NATIVE_RULE_TEST:'+json.dumps({'argv':p.args,'exit_code':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr}),flush=True);assert p.returncode==0,'native PromQL semantic checks failed'
print('OWNED_RULE_CLEANUP:'+json.dumps({'directory_removed':not root.exists(),'child_processes_reaped':True,'uid':os.getuid(),'controlled_metric_inputs':True,'physical_fault_or_grafana_render_claim':False}),flush=True)
